_about: Pixel measurements of reference marks, made 2026-10-09 by a canvas script (bg = modal colour; ink = colour distance > 90; parts = 4-connected ink components; stroke = 2 x median distance-transform ridge of ink, as a fraction of bbox height; gap = same on background pixels enclosed by ink on both axes; combo = mark/wordmark split at the largest column gap > 1.8 x median). Heights are in source px. Indicative, not exact: anti-aliasing and gradients add noise.
